prompt:
Desktop web UI screenshot, 16:9 landscape, of Marketo's full program page (the overnight). Same visual world as the reference: warm newsprint paper #e6d8c6 with fiber grain, carbon ink #040303, extra-condensed athletic gothic for names (like Big Shoulders Display), Barlow Condensed agate labels, 3px solid black rules, square-cut everything, no rounded corners, no shadows, no glass. BTC silks are a red #e42c22 square with white letters BTC; ETH silks a blue #0756d0 square. Purse green #085324 for money only. This is a designed website, not a racetrack photo, not a poster.

The reference supplies palette, type, rules, silks squares, and stamp character. Do NOT copy the reference layout (no giant selected-horse call as the whole page, no program strip of three horses across the bottom).

STRUCTURE: (1) Thin masthead ~8% height: MARKETO left; weekday date; line "heroes fight dreamDEX BTC / ETH event markets"; EN/ID locale invert chips; ENTER A HORSE mark at right. (2) Below a 3px ink rule, a CONDITIONS OF RACE bar: invert chips ACTIVE (pressed, ink fill, hot-sheet type), INACTIVE idle, then sort chips AGE, CREATED, PNL, TVL. (3) The remaining viewport is a TOTE: full-bleed agate table of horses as rows. Columns: program number in extra-condensed gothic, silks square, NAME, AGE (e.g. 14d), CREATED date, PnL with + in purse green or loss in carbon ink, TVL as a ruled filling ink bar toward a printed MAX, ACTIVE or SCRATCHED inverted tag. Rows: 1 WARDEN BTC, 2 KITE ETH, 3 REDLINE BTC, 4 ASH ETH, plus two more named GLAZE and HOLLOW. Tiny inverted SYNTHETIC tags on figures. (4) A Hot Sheet overlay (~40% width) has slid in from the RIGHT over the table, 55% wash #f3eadc, 3px ink edge: huge condensed name WARDEN, BTC silks, past-performance rows, a ruled TVL bar filling toward MAX 20000, last backer line "DEPOSIT 250 USDso  0x8f…  2h" with SYNTHETIC tag, amount underline, green rubber-stamp DEPOSIT. The left of the tote remains visible so this is overlay not a new page.

Visitor job (scan the field, then back the opened horse) must be readable from the image alone. No neon, no Inter, no fake press, no testimonials.
